title: review: M-sync: merge origin/main (408738b) into goal/T-1403 and resolve the bus_mcp.py conflict so the wave-2 PR is mergeable
spec:
Goal T-1403, plan label M-sync (re-file of T-1582 with a corrected test id). goal/T-1403 (78f8c88, 26 commits ahead of origin/main) does not contain origin/main 408738b (PRs 35, 36, 37 merged after the goal branch forked), and `git merge-tree` reports exactly one conflict: orchestrator/bus_mcp.py, the bus_create_task tool body. origin/main's side (T-1517, PR 37) returns a compact echo: `created = bus.create_task(...); echo = bus._compact_row(created); echo.update({"acceptance_count": len(acceptance), "scope_count": len(scope), "spec_chars": len(spec)}); return echo` with the docstring 'Planner only. Create a task; rejected without acceptance criteria and scope paths.' The goal side (T-1438, E8) changed only the docstring to 'Planner only. Create a task; depends_on accepts task ids or plan labels of siblings.' and returns bus.create_task(...) directly.

Do, in the task worktree (cut from goal/T-1403):
1. `git fetch origin` then `git merge --no-ff origin/main` (origin/main must be 408738b or its descendant) with the commit message 'M-sync: merge origin/main into goal/T-1403 (wave-2 PR)'. Resolve orchestrator/bus_mcp.py by keeping origin/main's compact-echo body and combining the docstrings: 'Planner only. Create a task; rejected without acceptance criteria and scope paths; depends_on accepts task ids or plan labels of siblings.' Every other file auto-merges; do not edit anything else and do not rebase (the branch history must stay intact: 26 task commits are referenced by bus records).
2. Confirm both sides' behaviour after the merge by running tests/test_bus.py, tests/test_pool.py, tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_planner_context.py in the foreground; fix nothing beyond the conflict unless a test fails only because of the merge, and say so in the result.
3. Commit the merge; the result names the merge commit sha. Do not run the full gate; the daemon does.

Note for the Planner (not the executor): the merge queue rebases task branches, which would flatten this merge commit, so after the gate and the security review approve, the Planner fast-forwards goal/T-1403 to the merge commit by hand (`git branch -f goal/T-1403 <merge sha>`, goal/T-1403 is not checked out anywhere) and pushes it; a 'merge rebase_conflict' or 'failed rebase_conflict' outcome from the daemon for this task is expected and harmless.

Scope: every file origin/main changed since the fork plus bus_mcp.py (listed in scope); out of scope: any other file. Rollback: `git branch -f goal/T-1403 78f8c88` (the pre-sync head).
acceptance: tests/test_bus.py::test_bus_create_task_echoes_compact_row: passes after the merge (origin/main's compact echo kept in orchestrator/bus_mcp.py bus_create_task)
tests/test_bus.py::test_create_task_resolves_plan_label_depends_on: passes after the merge (the goal branch's plan-label depends_on resolution kept)
tests/test_pool.py::test_pick_planner_honours_pinned_account: passes after the merge (origin/main's Planner account pin kept)

result.summary: Merge commit 1827be6 has parents 78f8c88 (goal head) and 408738b (origin/main), so the 26 task commits are intact and the message matches the spec. In orchestrator/bus_mcp.py, bus_create_task keeps origin/main's compact-echo body (_compact_row plus acceptance_count, scope_count and spec_chars). The docstring is the combined one the spec asked for. The call passes constraints before depends_on, matching the bus.create_task signature, so the goal side's plan-label depends_on resolution is not affected. The bus_read changes (parent, ids, row-count notice) come from origin/main and merged cleanly. All 15 changed files are in the scope list. I read the bus_mcp.py hunks and the diffstat only. I did not run the named tests or the full gate, so those acceptance criteria are not confirmed by this review. The only note is that bus_create_task now calls the private bus._compact_row from bus_mcp.py, but that is origin/main's design and not part of this merge.
